newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin falls to a six-month low of 14 rgt.
newsitem.headline: KL tin falls to a six-month low of 14 rgt.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell to a six-month low to end at 14 ringgit ($5.57) a kg after a lower London market discouraged foreign demand and more selling.

Traders said there was an opening bid of only six tonnes against offer of 99 tonnes. Turnover was 61 tonnes against 79 on Wednesday. "The market was weak because of a lower London and expectation of poor demand at current levels," a trader said.
Traders said the market is expected to drift at around current levels. The local price premium dropped slightly to $75 a tonne from $85. -Tan Lee Lee (603-275-6834) ($1=2.5100 rgt)
